answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded stake that is only refundable after the agent's vouched-for peers confirm it actually behaved. Each new identity must lock capital behind a hardware-rooted attestation, so a thousand puppets require a thousand real deposits, not a thousand free signups. One misbehaving clone gets slashed to zero and its attestation becomes a negative signal to every future counterparty. Without that thin layer of shale-like bedrock under each claim, a haven of fake accounts forms instantly; with it, cloning costs more than honest work.
